title: Southall Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, walk-in centres, and essential supply points for Southall.
content:
For life-threatening medical emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals
- Ealing Hospital: Uxbridge Road, Southall UB1 3HW. From Southall station: ~25 min walk east along South Road and Uxbridge Road, or take bus 207, 427, or SL8 east along Uxbridge Road (~10 mins).
- Hillingdon Hospital: Pield Heath Road, Uxbridge UB8 3NN. From Southall station: ~4.5 miles west; take bus 427 west along Uxbridge Road towards Uxbridge, or bus 278.
- St Mary's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Praed Street, London W2 1NY. From Southall station: ~20 mins on the Elizabeth line east direct to London Paddington station.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Ealing Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Uxbridge Road, Southall UB1 3HW (co-located with A&E at Ealing Hospital main entrance).

3. Local Hazard Notes
- River Brent floodplain to the east (Brent River Park) and the Grand Union Canal cutting through central/southern Southall present flood risks during sustained heavy rain.

4. Essential Supplies
- Pharmacies and large grocery retailers along The Broadway (Uxbridge Road), South Road, and Western Road supply water, first-aid items, and medication during outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
